BiblicalUsage: A measuring cord is the line of the temple and the city: a line of thirty cubits did compass the molten sea round about, and the measuring line shall yet go forth over against it upon the hill Gareb, and a line shall be stretched forth upon Jerusalem.
TheologicalSignificance: I read the line as the measure of what God builds, and the stretching forth as the promise that He will build again.
RelatedPeople: King Solomon; Jeremiah; Zechariah the Prophet
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
